channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Mazzulla | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Mazzulla from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Scalabrine then talked about the advice that Jordan shared with Mazzulla in his hangouts with the two NBA legends.

“He [Mazzulla] told them at the partners' summit that he actually hung out with Michael Jordan and Phil Jackson this summer. And Jordan told Joe that 'the reason why I kept winning was I acted like I never won,'”

Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson, Joe Mazzulla, Sep 23, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Mike Conley on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Mike Conley on playing for Joe Mazzulla:

“I get here, I feel like I don't know what I'm doing”

Mike Conley on Joe Mazzulla, Sep 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Caleb Grill on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Caleb Grill on Joe Mazzulla:

“I just like how intense he is. How straight to the point he is, and there's no cutting corners with him. And I like how straightforward he is with everything.”

Caleb Grill on Joe Mazzulla, Jul 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Derrick White on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Derrick White on Joe Mazzulla:

“He's a great basketball mind. He thinks the game like no one I've really been around. All the stories of him just being crazy just how he is every single day. It's not for the media, nothing. He just goes out there and he's like, all these stories that the media hears about me is like people telling it. I don't go out there and do all this stuff.”

Derrick White on Joe Mazzulla, Jun 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Neemias Queta on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
‪Bobby Krivitsky‬: Neemias Queta on Joe Mazzulla continuing to challenge and push him on a career night where he had 27 points, 17 rebounds, and 3 blocks:

“That's huge. Like, it’s easy when you have a night like this to like, settle down…when Joe comes, keeps coming at you like that, you're only going to get better.”

Neemias Queta on Joe Mazzulla, Mar 2, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“What I will say is Neemi has been getting better each year, and Coach Mazzulla has been pretty tough on him,”

Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla, Sep 2, 2025. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Anfernee Simons on Jaylen Brown, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“I mean, they obviously aren’t going to play the same way they played when they had (Kristaps) Porzingis and (Al) Horford and Holiday. Joe Mazzulla’s going to have to completely change the style of play. And Simons… nobody can score like him on that team other than Brown. He’s the second-best scorer, and it’s not even close.”

Anfernee Simons on Jaylen Brown, Joe Mazzulla, Aug 29, 2025. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla’s comments about him maintaining perspective:

“It comes pretty naturally to me, especially playing here in Boston, getting this love. For me, it’s like, no better place to do it. The biggest stage and getting all this love. This is what I dreamed of.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla, Apr 24, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Bill Chisholm on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
New Boston Celtics owner Bill Chisholm tells ESPN:

“The team is in a great place right now, and I'm very sensitive to that. Wyc, Brad (Stevens) and Joe (Mazzulla) have done amazing jobs... My approach is to win and raise banners. That's in the near term and the long term.”

Bill Chisholm on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla, Mar 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Torrey Craig on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
More from Craig on Mazzulla:

“He don’t care about anything. He just wants to win. I’m the same way.”

Torrey Craig on Joe Mazzulla, Feb 21, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“We had not been focused on [coming here]. We got through raising the banner, and opening night, and then it was all business, led by [Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla]. Joe doesn't really want us to dwell too much on the past. He wants us to move forward. But, having said that, everybody here -- including Joe -- really seemed to have a great time.”

Wyc Grousbeck on Joe Mazzulla, Nov 21, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“I’m the one that’s setting the tone and getting off to a hot start. But I think [coach Joe Mazzulla] wants to switch it up a little bit. I guess it’s cool. I can do whatever our team needs to be done. Whoever needs to feel comfortable in order to get the game started, whatever, I’ll figure it out.”

Jaylen Brown on Joe Mazzulla, Oct 29, 2024. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jaylen Brown, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla:

“I was sitting in front of Jaylen yesterday at the baseball game, andJaylen said, ‘Joe is going to take something from this and we're going to be playing shortstop or something next year to get ready for a game.’”

Brad Stevens on Jaylen Brown, Joe Mazzulla, Jun 26, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeff Van Gundy on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Jeff Van Gundy:

“Because I decided I was going to stay in broadcasting, I turned both opportunities down. Then I got let go by ESPN, and I re-visited it with Brad. And, he was great. We had talked about everything about this consultancy position, from G-League to coaching, a lot of different things. They didn’t need my help or anything like that, but I’m beyond grateful to have someone help me out like Brad and Joe (Mazzulla) did. And also give me real work.”

Jeff Van Gundy on Joe Mazzulla, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
John Karalis:Jaylen Brown on Joe Mazzulla:

“Joe's mentality is fantastic. Even today, one of my favorite quotes he said today, he was like, there's no such thing as a foul (in a war). Either you survive or you don't. Just that resonates with me because I like stuff like that.”

Jaylen Brown on Joe Mazzulla, Jun 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @John_Karalis.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Brown:

“The coaching staff has been fantastic all year long ... super organized, we walk through all types of scenarios ...they tell us everything, super transparent and we trusted it ... (Mazzulla) has been coaching his ass off.”

Jaylen Brown on Joe Mazzulla, Jun 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Sam Hauser on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
lol Sam Hauser on Joe Mazzulla:

“I would just say he’s like got a unique approach to the game. He pulls things from, like, soccer teams, pulls things from killer whales and how they go about finding food and prey, things like that.”

Sam Hauser on Joe Mazzulla, Jun 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Will Hardy on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Will Hardy on Joe Mazzulla:

“He’s a really special coach. He just seems to be more comfortable in a lot of ways, which is to be expected.”

Will Hardy on Joe Mazzulla, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Kristaps Porziņģis on Joe Mazzulla this year:

“It’s easy to not give him credit because of the talent we have, but he deserves a lot of credit.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla, Feb 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla pulling him and Brown/Holiday early in the third:

“We deserved it. We were pissed off at ourselves. I understood it. You never want to come out of the game, but something needed to change.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Joe Mazzulla, Feb 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Derrick White on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“Hearing from some of the top guys in the league that they want you to be aggressive, it obviously gives you confidence, and Joe (Mazzulla) has given me confidence since the moment he stepped into the head-coaching position,”

Derrick White on Joe Mazzulla, Oct 28, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Paul Pierce, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Brian Robb:Rajon Rondo on Joe Mazzulla sending an email out to Celtics alumni inviting them to come back more:

“Paul (Pierce) called me at like 3 in the morning. He was like, ‘They want us back.’ I’m like, ‘Hello?’”

Rajon Rondo on Paul Pierce, Joe Mazzulla, Oct 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“This is the way Stevens and Mazzulla want to play. And if they’ gonna go down, and if they’re gonna take a step back and if they’re gonna fail, just know that it was the two of them in alignment going forward.”

Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla, Jul 19, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“I went to the gym next day to get my stuff, talked to Brad (Stevens) and Joe (Mazzulla),”

Marcus Smart on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla, Jul 2, 2023. Source: CLNSMedia.com.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Sam Cassell, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“I’m going to add to what I got right now. I’ve got to add to it. It’s already good! I’ve got to add to it. It’s already there. So,I’m bringing Mazzulla back but maybe I’m bringing in a veteran coach, like Sam Cassell. Some influence on the bench. Respect. A champion. Been a coach. Understands what it takes.”

Paul Pierce on Sam Cassell, Joe Mazzulla, Jun 3, 2023. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla:

“I think when you consider the position he was thrust into and the overall accomplishments of the group, I thought he did a really good job.”

Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla:

“I thought he did a really good job. When you look at it in the big picture, and having a team that was 2nd in offense, 2nd in defense, won 57 games ... There's a lot of direction and organization that goes into that.”

Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Joe Mazzulla:

“He's a sharp guy. His care factor is through the roof. His maturity is beyond his years...he's earned (the players) trust.”

Erik Spoelstra on Joe Mazzulla, May 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Jay King:Jayson Tatum on Joe Mazzulla:

“He’s been great all season. Just managing personalities, managing games. … His faith in us, our faith in him. I say it all the time, this is like a relationship. We’re all on the same page. … he always finds a way to maintain his poise.”

Jayson Tatum on Joe Mazzulla, Apr 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla:

“I know he gives a damn about everybody in that locker room. He really, really cares. It eats him up when something doesn’t go well individually for a guy. It eats him up when he feels like he’s let the team down.”

Brad Stevens on Joe Mazzulla, Feb 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.
